outcome: neonatal morbidities (hyperbilirubinemia, respiratory distress syndrome, infections, necrotizing enterocolitis)
cohort: 150 pregnant women with fetal growth restriction (FGR) at Ziauddin Medical University Hospital, Karachi, from December 1, 2006, to November 30, 2007
finding: The majority of babies born with FGR had a birth weight greater than 1.5 kg and an Apgar score > 5.
mod_finding: 48% of the patients with FGR delivered via cesarean section while 52% delivered vaginally.
gest_age: less than 36 weeks in 15.3% of women, more than 36 weeks in 84.7%
birth_weight: more than 1.5 kg in 147 cases, less than 1.5kg in 3 cases
